figures.name: soak-and-watchers
figures.title: Continuous use and many watchers on one daemon (release, stand-in model)
figures.question: What grows with use, and how many watchers can one daemon serve?
figures.note: Soak: two clients, each one growing session (a file read, then a reply; the stand-in answers in about 30 ms), 8 minutes. Watchers: connections each watching one session, one turn on it; the stand-in streams for about 0.5 s.
